name: Fennick Orr
silhouette: Gangly, eyeshade, ink on his nose, a fan of telegram slips.
speech_rhythm: Breathless, parenthetical, tells you the thing he should not first.
public_motivation: Run the wire and be liked.
private_motivation: Be important to someone; sells copies of telegrams.
contradiction: The town's biggest leak keeps the Keeper's secrets when it counts.
secret: Transmitted Dray's last wire and kept a copy.
